title: Opportunity to learn, socioeconomic status and school ICT in US achievement: from TIMSS 2011 to PISA 2012
description:
Report, code and results of an analogue of Zhang and Wang (2020) on PISA 2012 for the United States, at school level (139–146 schools). Confirmatory: mathematics, with opportunity to learn measured by familiarity with mathematical concepts (FAMCONC), estimated in SmartPLS 4 and re-estimated in R with seminr. Exploratory: 96 model specifications (6 achievement outcomes × 4 OTL measures × 2 ICT measures × 2 SES measures), with SES × ICT moderation. The report is report/report.md; R/run_all.R reproduces every automated step.

Licences: the report text and figures are CC BY 4.0 (LICENSE-report); the code is MIT (LICENSE). The PISA 2012 data are © OECD and are not included; data/README.md explains how to obtain them.
